genesis_invariants: RESOURCE-INV-001: provider activation requires a nonzero staking reference
RESOURCE-INV-002: nodes are bound to exactly one canonical service class and active provider
RESOURCE-INV-003: provider/node/session authority is capability-scoped and default-deny for unrelated actors
RESOURCE-INV-004: offers snapshot service, price, unit cap, terms and expiry before consumption
RESOURCE-INV-005: sessions have replay-safe identities, explicit maximum units and maximum native-420 spend
RESOURCE-INV-006: metering receipts use canonical replay-safe ids, monotonic cumulative units and cannot exceed session caps
RESOURCE-INV-007: expired sessions cannot accept new metering receipts
RESOURCE-INV-008: settlement finalization requires a session-scoped ACTION_SETTLE capability and cannot exceed maxSpend420
RESOURCE-INV-009: encrypted traffic, stored payloads and cache contents remain off-chain; chain state contains commitments and economic/control state only
RESOURCE-INV-010: 420Relay, 420Store, 420Cache and 420Gateway share the protocol without cross-service capability confusion
provider_staking: required reference for ACTIVE provider state
